plan: My value for the prize is $30. To maximize profit, I should bid slightly below my value to ensure a positive payoff if I win. Assuming others bid near their values, a bid of $25 might secure a win without overpaying. If others bid higher, I lose but incur no cost. This balances winning chances and profit maximization.

Given my value of $28, my goal is to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win. Assuming others bid close to their values, I expect them to bid between $20-$30. If I bid $27, I could win against bids below $27 and pay the third-highest bid. This maximizes profit while keeping the bid competitive.

Given my value of $22, I aim to bid below my value to maximize profit. If I bid $20, I might win against cautious bidders, paying the third-highest bid, potentially lower than $20. If others overvalue, I lose nothing. This balances winning chances and cost.
